Container.Name: DeckMover
Container.Overview: Warm Unraid cache with Plex Continue Watching items using direct SQLite database access. Optionally moves watched items back to the array.

Config.Name: Array Root
Config.Description: Source (array only, not user share)

Config.Name: Cache Root
Config.Description: Destination cache drive

Config.Name: Plex Database
Config.Description: Plex appdata root (must contain Library/Application Support/Plex Media Server/...)

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Config directory

Config.Name: Logs
Config.Description: Log directory

Config.Name: PLEX_PATH_MAP
Config.Description: Path mapping from Plex container paths to Unraid host paths. Format: /plex_path=/host_path. Comma-separated for multiple mappings.

Config.Name: PLEX_LIBRARIES
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of Plex library names to include. Leave blank for all libraries.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file ownership (99 = nobody on Unraid)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file ownership (100 = users on Unraid)

Config.Name: DECKMOVER_ONDECK
Config.Description: Include On Deck / Continue Watching items

Config.Name: DECKMOVER_ONDECK_COUNT
Config.Description: Max On Deck items per user

Config.Name: DECKMOVER_WARM_MOVE
Config.Description: Delete array source after verified copy to cache. Prevents duplicates in user shares.

Config.Name: DECKMOVER_WARM_SIDECARS
Config.Description: Copy subtitle and metadata sidecar files alongside media

Config.Name: DECKMOVER_MOVE_WATCHED_BACK
Config.Description: Move fully watched items from cache back to array

Config.Name: DECKMOVER_MOVE_BACK_MIN_AGE_DAYS
Config.Description: Only move back items watched more than N days ago. 0 = any age.

Config.Name: DECKMOVER_MOVE_BACK_SIDECARS
Config.Description: Move sidecar files alongside media during move-back

Config.Name: DECKMOVER_MIN_FREE_GB
Config.Description: Minimum free space to leave on cache after run (GB)

Config.Name: DECKMOVER_RESERVE_GB
Config.Description: Additional buffer on top of MIN_FREE that is never used (GB)

Config.Name: DECKMOVER_TRIM_PLAN
Config.Description: If plan exceeds available space, trim it to fit. If false, abort the run instead.

Config.Name: DECKMOVER_MAX_ITEMS
Config.Description: Hard cap on total items across all users

Config.Name: DECKMOVER_TIME
Config.Description: Daily run time (HH:MM). Leave blank if using DECKMOVER_CRON or DECKMOVER_RUN_IMMEDIATELY.

Config.Name: DECKMOVER_CRON
Config.Description: Cron expression for scheduling (e.g. 0 */2 * * * for every 2 hours). Overrides DECKMOVER_TIME.

Config.Name: DECKMOVER_RUN_IMMEDIATELY
Config.Description: Run once immediately then exit. Use with RSYNC_DRY_RUN=true for testing.

Config.Name: DECKMOVER_LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: Log verbosity: error, warn, info, or debug

Config.Name: RSYNC_DRY_RUN
Config.Description: Simulate run without modifying any files. Use with DECKMOVER_RUN_IMMEDIATELY=true for testing.
